description: This source file implements a generic singly linked list class with methods to add elements, retrieve elements by index, and get the list size. It includes internal node management and overrides the toString method to provide a string representation of the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A minimal generic singly linked list class supporting basic operations such as add, get, size, and string representation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index is invalid.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the list elements.
